sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Dhiraj Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1. Heard Sri Dhiraj Singh, learned counsel for applicant and Sri B.P. Singh, learned Aga for State.
2. This is second bail application of applicant.
Applicant is a lady who is facing trial for offence U/s 323, 325, 376(A)(B) IPC and 3(B), 4(2), 5N/6 POCSO Act.
3. As per status report of trial Court dated 16.04.2025, prosecution has now proposed six witnesses.
Statement of victim has already been recorded, whereas statement of PW-2 is at the stage of cross examination.
4. Learned counsel for applicant submits that entire prosecution story is false; medical report of victim does not support allegation and since statement of victim has already been recorded,

1 therefore, taking note that applicant is in jail since 20.03.2023 i.e. for more than 2 years and 3 months, she may be released on bail.
5. Per contra, learned AGA has opposed the bail and submits that statement of complainant is still not concluded, therefore, threat to influence witnesses does exist.

6. I have considered above submissions and taking note of age of victim is about 8 years, nature of her testimony and manner of occurrence as well as that all material witnesses are not examined till date, therefore, this Court does not find any ground to consider prayer for bail at this stage.
8. However, a liberty is granted to applicant to approach this Court or trial Court, as advised, along with fresh status report if the trial is not concluded within a period of eight months.
